notes.subject: 2026 decline - local provider / activity spots filled
notes.body: Jenny Morgan replied Aug. 28, 2026 that Broomfield Days is still working with a local provider and has filled its activity spots for 2026. She said she will keep The Adventure Zone's information on hand for future events. Treat 2026 as a clean decline, not a do-not-contact.

followUps.label: Follow up with Jenny about 2027 Broomfield Days
followUps.reason: 2026 was filled with a local provider, but Jenny said she would keep The Adventure Zone's information on hand for future events. Check back early for 2027 before activity spots are filled.
